serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I did it!
Big Daddy: Congratulations, little one!
You: Oh, I think you are the first person to actually congratulate me since I started these trips.
Big Daddy: Oh, but of course! It’s only natural. 
Big Daddy: Unlike all those other crude men, I want to make it easier for you. 
#BigDaddyHurt.Face.bdhSmile
Big Daddy: It’s only a matter of time for all these people to leave you. There’s always someone better, stronger. A bigger fish that will captivate them in a way you never could. I just want you to enjoy yourself before da inevitable comes…
You: That’s… I feel like you were only pretending to be nice…
